'''2007 Georgia State Championship Gabe Taylor DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Gabe Taylor]] at [[2007 Georgia State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' AoBS Sevens
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
